t: Look up at the side of the John Lewis department store on Holles Street, near the junction with Oxford Street. This is Winged Figure, a sculpture by Barbara Hepworth, installed in April 1963. It's one of her best known works, and it's estimated that around two hundred million people see it each year. Hepworth was a leading English modernist sculptor, and during the Second World War she was part of the colony of artists living in St Ives, alongside Ben Nicholson and Naum Gabo.
